correctness.rationale: The exact polynomial identity 24P(x)+1=((x-3/2)^2-5/4)^2 reduces collisions to reflection t->5/2-t on quadratic residues. The explicit quadratic character sum gives T_p; the singular value c0=3/128 occurs without a nonsingular preimage precisely when chi_p(10)=-1; c1=-1/24 occurs precisely when chi_p(5)=1. Nonexceptional roots Hensel-lift to full residue balls. The local factors (-5/48)u^2(1-2u^2/5) and (u^2-5/4)^2/24 give p-adic square balls via unit-derivative coordinate changes. S_p(k-2) counts their reductions, while their p-adic measure is 1/(2p(p+1)). Independent enumeration compared actual output sets with the stated formula for feasible powers of seven good primes. The finite check only supplements these all-depth algebraic steps.
